request.text:
A: There's a Warden crypt in the Sunscar, sealed before the Fall. And they say the third ember came down in the crater beside it.
<long pause>
B: Gather them before she does. When you hold them all, you'll stand in Ember Keep with a choice to make, and I'd rather it were yours than hers.
